title: Make named properties
summary: PowerShell: Make named properties. Add an Author property.
introduction: A custom object groups properties. Dot notation reads a property.

blocks.text: Open PowerShell 7. Paste one example or save it as lesson.ps1 and run pwsh -NoProfile -File lesson.ps1. No administrator access is needed.
The custom object stores Pages as a property. Dot access reads 24.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Object properties and a formatted display are not the same thing.
